verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Pipecat Cloud pricing page, which advertises Krisp-powered noise suppression that removes background noise and voices that cause false interruptions. That directly targets the story, but it is a single marketing mention tied to the Cloud offering, not documented framework configuration. missing for 10: first-party docs on how to enable or configure noise suppression or audio filters in a pipeline, evidence of open-source/self-hosted filter options, details on telephony-call applicability, independent or hands-on corroboration of effectiveness.
